title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Strategy yield wrapper lands in Europe as 21Shares lists STRC ETP
summary: 21Shares debuts the Strategy Yield ETP on Euronext Amsterdam on Thursday, giving Europe regulated access to Strategy’s preferred stock, which is heavily backed by Bitcoin.

title: Revolut among 4 companies chosen to test stablecoins in UK sandbox
summary: The UK Financial Conduct Authority selected Monee, ReStabilise, Revolut and VVTX to test stablecoin issuance and payments in its regulatory sandbox beginning in Q1 2026.

title: South Korea moves to require crypto, stock influencers to disclose holdings: Report
summary: A proposed law would require online investment influencers to reveal their holdings and paid promotions, with penalties potentially comparable to market manipulation violations.

title: FG Nexus sells another $14M in Ether as losses mount on treasury bet
summary: FG Nexus sold another $14 million in Ether from its corporate treasury, bringing its losses to over $80 million as Ether-focused balance sheets come under mounting market pressure.

title: Aave governance dispute escalates as ACI and Aave Labs publish dueling reports
summary: Competing reports outline contrasting views on protocol revenue, development and funding accountability.

title: Bitcoin price climbs 3% as gold divergence signals ‘significant upside’
summary: Bitcoin’s failure to replicate gains in gold and stocks over the last six months may result in a delayed rally as BTC price returns to $65,000.

title: US senator launches probe into Binance over Iran, Russia sanctions claims
summary: Binance rejected the allegations, saying it flags suspicious activity, enforces strict compliance procedures and does not permit Iranian users on the platform.

title: Bitcoin bounces to $66K as rumors swirl over Jane Street selling algorithm
summary: Bitcoin traders had mixed opinions over what caused a BTC price rebound past $66,000 as attention focused on Jane Street selling pressure.

title: Anchorage buys STRC as Wall Street shorts mount against Saylor’s Bitcoin proxy
summary: Strategy has become the most-shorted large-cap US stock as hedge funds ramp up bearish bets, according to data from Goldman Sachs.
